title: I opened up my browser game’s engine so you can play with the sky, trees and entities
author: Reasonable-Dark1992
selftext:
I’m making [Hollow County](http://playhollowcounty.com), a pixel-art zombie game that runs in the browser. I put together a free page where you can mess with the engine behind it. It runs the real game engine.



There are three tools:



Sky & weather: change the clouds layer by layer, switch the weather, strike lightning, and speed up time to watch days and seasons go by.

Trees & grass: watch the leaves change colour and fall, cover everything in snow, crank up the wind, and grow any tree you like.

Creatures: spawn zombies, animals and characters anywhere, follow one with the camera, and swap their looks.

You don’t need to sign up or download anything. It’s best on a computer, but it works on phones too.



[playhollowcounty.com/dev](http://playhollowcounty.com/dev)



Feedback welcome, and I’m happy to answer questions about how any of it works.
